parent.source: certified common-protocol R18 seed0 full checkpoint, EMA.module only

precision: original BF16 forward, FP32 losses; no scaler
view_rule: every arm consumes only original whole-image views (position-mapped, no draws); no tile mixing; identical paired data order for all three arms
data: original train_core 4869; 4864 views/pass, original drop_last5 rule; seed0 sampler epochs109..120
augmentation: original RawAugmentation; local pass1..12 maps epoch109..120; strong first9, off last3; flip always retained; no fixed crops
crop_gt: unchanged; the whole-image path performs no fixed crop (view 0 = full image, original raw rows)
ignore: unchanged original category0/score0 handling; original normal-unmatched-class negative mask, native DN unchanged
empty: keep empty GT view, no resample; original denominator min1, DN/no-DN handling unchanged
optimizer: new AdamW; original norm/bn name groups, betas0.9/0.999, WD1e-4 except norm/bn0; clip0.1; all arms identical

ema.init: copy newly loaded parent EMA model incl buffers

BN: parent EMA buffers copied byte-exact; original module train/eval and frozen norm behavior; no recalibration or BN changes
RNG: installation consumes no global RNG draws (explicit seeded generator); chain resets Python/NumPy/torchCPU/CUDA seed0 after each independent construction; identical source order and augmentation stream for G0/G1/G2; view choices draw nothing

install.G2_detail: wrap backbone (key-preserving) + capture stride-4 stage output; pixel_unshuffle(2) 64ch->256ch + 1x1 conv (explicit-seed xavier) + zero-init per-channel gate; added to proj_feats[0] AFTER the native input_proj, BEFORE flatten/concat; inference retained
install.G1_control: identical module/parameters/compute; source = proj_feats[0] (level-0 projected feature, stop-gradient copy) so no sub-stride information enters
install.operator_note: pixel_unshuffle + 1x1 linear is algebraically a 2x2 stride-2 convolution on the stride-4 tensor (space-to-depth family); no originality claimed; no new literature sweep this round
install.gradient: branch input stop-gradient in BOTH arms (fixed mechanism); main path gradients unchanged and trainable; only gate+conv train; forward guard enforces the detach; acceptance probe checks zero-gate output/loss/shared-gradient bitwise identity vs the parent-loaded native twin

endpoint: FT012 EMA only; save each pass, no intermediate AP/epoch selection
inference: original A only (whole-image), Q300, FP32, 548 development, top600/top300, original two evaluators and raw-ignore; truncate then filter, no refill; no C views this round
verdict: quality = all7 pre-registered A_G2_minus_G1 unrounded COCO-bridge pp conditions pass; A_G2_minus_G0 and A_G2_minus_parent fully adjudicated (same minima shown for reference, descriptive); beating only the capacity control without baseline net benefit is not recorded as a successful improvement; a single paired seed is exploratory, not repeatability proof
future_stop: new integrity/numerical/resource/restore exception STOP, preserve; at most one evidenced engineering fix-and-retry, counted in the budget; no changes to batch/precision/lr/data or the scientific mechanism; nonfinite numerics or budget overrun STOP, no auto-expansion; no checkpoint selection, no eval tuning, no new seeds
retention: server keeps complete checkpoints/predictions/audits/ledger; D keeps only necessary reports/config/metrics/SHA indexes; verified completed arm artifacts are retained
note: this plan file replaces the whole-slice v1 for the three-arm round; shared training math and frozen numbers are identical to r18_slice_finetune_v1.json except views/arms/install/gates as declared above
